theorems.statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (f : Euclid m → Euclid P), Measurable (fun x => Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single l 1))))) ∧ ∀ s : Set (Euclid m), MeasurableSet s → (∀ x ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ f x) → (∀ x ∈ s, Injective (fderiv ℝ f x)) → InjOn f s → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in f '' s, g y ∂μHE[m] = ∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single l 1))))) * g (f x) ∂volume
